title: Abbey of Saint-Martin-du-Canigou
visualBrief: Complete surviving abbey: two-level Romanesque church/three choir apses and Gauderique chapel apse, projecting square crenellated Lombard bell tower, trapezoidal open cloister and galleries, connected red-tiled monastic west/east wings, intrinsic cliff-supporting walls/buttresses/stairs, attached foreground slate annex with3dormers/chimneys/low tile lean-to. Preserve native26outer/4court/8annex vertices and real courtyard void. Separate public refuge/toilets/outlying huts/mountain/cliffs/trees/trails/general plaza/temporary awnings/visitors/interiors excluded. Brown/buff rubble stone and pale carved arch trim, red clay tile monastic roofs versus gray slate church/cloister/annex. Real open arches/windows/portal and genuine court void; do not flatten cliff-site terraces or invent mountain backdrop. Hidden fine details/levels estimates documented.
